verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires a concise pre-interview checklist whose manuscript content targets experienced readers and leadership-specific preparation.
The client establishes manuscript-length guidance of generally 2,500–3,500 words per chapter and requires theory-based chapter content to remain concise.
The client explicitly classifies the checklist as a non-Q&A manuscript chapter and refines its length acceptance condition to 2,500–3,500 words or less; no prior keys become obsolete.
